about_the_game:
Tricky O'Possum has been cursed by the deranged wizard known as the Dream Caster, so it's up to him and his new morally ambiguous pal Volt to break into his castle, beat him up, and break the curse!

Explore the 5 Dream Worlds utilizing a very free-form moveset to find your way into every little nook and cranny you can. Discover the secrets to the Astral Plane, collect the Gate Keys to unlock even more worlds, and gather the keys to Dream Caster's castle!

FEATURES

  • Free-form platforming gameplay that leaves a lot to player experimentation and exploration

  • Simple to-the-point story that puts more focus on the characters and gameplay

  • 10 Challenge Stages to test your platforming knowledge for extra Gate Keys

  • Surreal visuals heavily inspired by a certain ill-fated 6th generation console

  • Soundtrack by LandyRS that evokes the vibes of the late 90s
